policies.text: Inclusion in the prioritized vendor roster is recommended for any business unit cleared through primary onboarding.
Outstanding service delivery recognition is awarded when a contractor records a customer satisfaction rating of at least 85 percent and completes 120 or more successful deliveries per quarter.
Master contract status is granted when a candidate earns a high performance rating while being recommended for inclusion in the prioritized vendor roster.
Adequate staffing validation is achieved by maintaining an active staff count of at least 30 full-time employees.
Accelerated payment processing is granted to suppliers maintaining a liquidity ratio above 25 percent.
System stability validation is confirmed if a service provider exhibits an uptime rating of 99.5 percent or higher, or maintains yearly cyber insurance coverage of $3,000,000 or more.
Basic security approval is awarded when a supplier carries ISO 27001 certification or maintains yearly cyber insurance coverage reaching at least $5,000,000.
Fiscal stability certification is granted to a commercial partner that generates gross annual revenue of $5,000,000 or greater.
Governance compliance approval is assigned to an enterprise that completes 10 or more internal compliance audits annually.
Rapid response verification is attained if a vendor maintains an average response time of 20 minutes or less, or possesses SOC 2 Type II compliance.
Tier-1 operational status is conferred on a vendor that secures system stability validation and obtains rapid response verification.
Prompt agreement signing is advised for any provider achieving corporate account tier advancement.
Official procurement clearance requires a contractor to hold a commercial vendor license.
Global distribution clearance is awarded when a distributor logs 500 regional shipments annually.
A firm qualifies for primary onboarding provided that the applicant gains basic security approval.

A supplier achieves a high performance rating either by holding ISO 27001 certification alongside a customer satisfaction rating of 90 percent or higher, or by recording 100 or more successful deliveries per quarter.
Corporate account tier advancement requires master contract status together with a dedicated account support staff of at least 4 headcount.
